تختطفي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطِفِي (taḵtaṭifī) /tax.ta.tˤi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# تُخْتَطَفِي (tuḵtaṭafī) /tux.ta.tˤa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
